tabular-classification.title: IRIS - Iris classification
tabular-classification.name: Iris classification
tabular-classification.summary: The classic to start with: the species of a flower from the measurements of its petals and sepals.

text: The Iris-Data dataset allows to detect what type of iris plant is from the altitude and length of its petal and sepalo.

example.text: Enter the values corresponding to the plant to be evaluated:
example.items: (sepal length; sepalo width; petal length; petal width).
